Santana Row 最能体现圣何塞的节奏：边走、边吃、边逛、边聊天，一天自然: Santana Row captures San Jose's pace: walk, eat, browse, and chat, and the day takes shape naturally. Valley Fair adds a large-mall experience, The Tech Interactive adds hands-on technology, and Winchester Mystery House adds a story. San Pedro Square Market works well for an evening gathering; Rose Garden or Japantown can slow the pace. Vietnamese food, shopping at Santana Row, and meeting at San Pedro Square Market are three distinctive South Bay weekend experiences.
